title: This Open Source AI Brain Runs Any Robot (LingBot VLA 2)
description:
Stop building AI agents, build a robot instead 🔥

Someone just dropped a "universal brain" for robots on GitHub and its kinda wild. It's called LingBot VLA 2, an open model that can drive all kinds of diffrent robots insted of being locked to one specific hardware.

The trick is how they trained it. Data from twenty diffrent robot setups, plus first person video from actual humans doing tasks. And through a single action representation it generelizes across totaly different "bodies", so one brain works on almost any build.

It's on GitHub under Robbyant lingbot vla v2 if you wanna dig in ✨😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
